description: One lake comparator check per book (a combined check of all headlines loads every book at once). Run one book with: ./scripts/verify-comparator.sh <book>. Each entry's config is a complete lake comparator configuration.

books.title: Milne, Modular Functions and Modular Forms, sections 0 to 10
Milne, Modular Functions and Modular Forms, sections 11 and 12 (Weil's theorem, elliptic curves, complex multiplication)
Shimura, Elementary Dirichlet Series and Modular Forms
Iwaniec, Topics in Classical Automorphic Forms
Andrianov and Zhuravlev, Modular Forms and Hecke Operators
The class number one theorem (Heegner 1952, Stark 1967), conditional on Weber's theorems
Waldspurger's theorems, the Shimura lift and Gross's example for p = 11 (unconditional and conditional on named inputs)
Congruent numbers and Tunnell's criterion (unconditional, conditional on named inputs, and conditional on the weak Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture)
Historical theorems of Jacobi, Ramanujan, Weber and Kronecker (unconditional; since 0.4.0 with the Jacobi triple product)
The Rankin-Selberg method at level one and the symmetric square L-function (unconditional)
Modular elliptic curves: functional equation, parity, strong Hasse-Weil (unconditional, and conditional on the modularity theorem)
Theta series of quadratic forms in one genus differ by a cusp form, every rank; Gross's form of level 11 in the plus space (unconditional)
Kohnen's plus space: Kohnen's isomorphism, the Kohnen-Zagier formula and Waldspurger's theorem on the plus space (conditional on named inputs)
